narration: A close friend was starting something in month {fork_month}, and you chose {real_choice}. The ghost took {ghost_choice}, and its {first_bar_apart} parted from yours that same month. The ghost's money reached its lowest in month {ghost_lowest_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Its cushion for a stretch with no pay ended {safety_gap}.
